Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a flawed source-weighting heuristic that prioritized an unverified auto-generated search snippet suggesting “Bellevue, Ohio” as a primary source and allowed conflation of identities, instead of relying on authoritative pages (Wikipedia/IMDb/Find a Grave) that consistently list New York City. This misinterpretation and mishandling of conflicting data set the workflow toward an incorrect birthplace.
